title: olbia thuringiaca
intro: Olbia thuringiaca, commonly known as the German angelica, is a plant species in the Apiaceae family. It is traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits in reducing inflammation and promoting digestion. The therapeutic actions of Olbia thuringiaca include its ability to stimulate circulation, lower blood pressure, and act as an antispasmodic and diuretic. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, coumarins, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to fully understand its effects.
